name: sdlc-skills
description: A plugin for coding agents: it writes stories by interviewing you and builds them, or a smaller task, against checks the agent writing the code never sees, answers open questions with spikes, and has hooks that decide when work is done and house rules for how the agent works with you.

plugins.name: agentic-dev
plugins.description: Two skills that take any change from a request to a merge, against checks the agent writing the code never sees: a task skill for a change one check proves done, which asks at most one clarifying question and for the check, hides the check, and has a subagent make it pass from the simplest solution up in its own worktree; and a story skill for a feature or a whole product, which interviews you until nothing is ambiguous, confirms the acceptance criteria in plain language, splits them into vertical-slice stories with a walking skeleton first and files them, then builds one story at a time: a reviewed plan, design choices settled with you, hidden failing tests, slices of at most 200 lines each built as a task and reviewed, a final review and verification, a merge request watched to merge, and the UAT. Plus a spike skill that answers one question with throwaway code (an experiment, a prototype, an ML eval, a hardware or load test) and records the finding, reviewer and verifier agents, and hooks for a done check that runs every test and the linter, an AGENTS.md size cap, a dependency gate, gates on commits that leave in debugging leftovers, switch a checker off, or change, remove or skip a test the branch started with, a gate that hides a check from the agent writing the code, a slice cap, a gate on the first edit no skill framed, and a gate on a pull request or merge no reviewer preceded.
